preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 1000
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 1000) representing the number of test cases.
Each of the T test cases consists of exactly 8 space-separated integers: N, A, B, C, D, E, F, G.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 50 for x in ' '.join(stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]).split() if x.isdigit())
preconditions.description: For each test case, A, B, C, D, E, F, G are integers between 1 and 50 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(N) < 10**100 for N in [line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is an integer such that 1 ≤ N < 10^100.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.split()) == T for stdout in [stdout.strip() for stdout in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T integers, one per test case.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.split()[i] == str(min_cost) for i, stdout in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()) if stdout.strip())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the minimum number of coins required to display some factor of N, where the cost of a digit d is defined as the sum of the coins for its active segments (as per the 7-segment display mapping).

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i]) >= 0 for i, stdout in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()) if stdout.strip())
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(any(int(stdout.split()[i]) == cost for cost in [sum(segment_costs(d) for d in str(factor)) for factor in get_factors(N)]) for i, stdout in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()) if stdout.strip())
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is the minimum cost among all factors of N, where the cost of a factor is the sum of the costs of its digits, and the cost of a digit is the sum of the coins for its active segments (as per the 7-segment display mapping).
